result.stdout:
Quarry Migration Tool

Usage: quarry <command> [options]

Commands:
  migrate add <name>       Scaffold a new migration from schema changes
  migrate add-empty <name> Create an empty migration for manual operations
  migrate list             List all migrations
  migrate validate         Validate migration integrity
  migrate remove           Remove the latest unapplied migration
  migrate diff             Preview schema changes without generating files
  migrate script           Generate incremental migration SQL for a version range
  migrate status           Show applied vs pending migration status (requires --connection)
  migrate squash           Collapse all migrations into a single baseline
  migrate bundle           Build a self-contained migration executable
  convert                  Convert Dapper calls to Quarry chain API (--from dapper)
  create-scripts           Generate full CREATE TABLE DDL from current schema
  scaffold                 Reverse-engineer an existing database to schema files
